ohtani.title: Padres clinch postseason berth with win over Dodgers

imanaga.title: Griffin Conine hits go-ahead single in Marlins' win

yoshida.title: Sonny Gray, Wilyer Abreu shine in 4-0 shutout win

okamoto.title: Encarnacion-Strand lifts Orioles to a 4-2 victory

murakami.title: Tristan Peters recaps the White Sox clinch
